items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, but those are all numbers. Everywhere, Miss Gretchen. Okay. Well here – see, I wanted to bring in, if you notice, Cass Tech says – it tells you on the record. One of my favorite young composers is Benny Golson, see. Benny Golson. That’s his number, not his number – but I took some of his chords, put them here, put them there, and added a lot of things – you won’t recognize it, really, but I’m telling you this is where the number got its chords, from Benny Golson.
